+def test_unpickle_with_device_pixel_ratio():
+    fig = Figure(dpi=42)
+    fig.canvas._set_device_pixel_ratio(7)
+    assert fig.dpi == 42*7
+    fig2 = pickle.loads(pickle.dumps(fig))
+    assert fig2.dpi == 42
